5ca6748a37b88b269472dad9: Rubble and Crew's favorite book series has new additions; the pups have a surprise just for Rubble, a snack dispenser.
The Guppies must use their nautical knowledge to save their party at sea when a giant ball of snow cone ice threatens to sink the party ship.
When small-town "puppy-saurus" Bubble Puppy gets picked to go against the reigning champ Boom Boom T. rex in the Tough Roarier competition, it's a battle of strength, speed and, above all, heart.
Gil is convinced a yeti is to blame when sleeping bags go missing.
The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.
Everyone in the Old West town of Harmony Valley loves playing music together; when noisy Billy Joe Strumlouder rides into town to sabotage their tunes, Sheriff Zooli must save the day.

In Holiday Land, there's a town for every holiday until Pirate Myra uses Wizard Grouper's magic wand to turn every town into Pirate Town; it's up to Molly and Gil to restore Holiday Land back to normal.
When Nonny breaks his glasses, he must use his other senses to reach the glasses store.
Nonnie must figure out how to lead the marching band when a duck gets in its way.
The Bubble Guppies learn about trees.
The children try to figure out how to get Mr. Grouper's car started after it breaks down on the way to an amusement park.

Ninjas Zooli and Oona are excited about their first mission: escorting snow monkey Moshi up Mt. Danger to join his troop; but it won't be easy: a storm looms, and mischievous Moshi is causing trouble.
The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.
After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.
When rain spoils a game of kickball, Gil invents a new game; Bubble Puppy must overcome his fear of thunder to save the game.
When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.

When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.
The Guppies learn about the zoo while trying to find a friend for a lonely rhinoceros.
Molly is going to have a new sibling; the Guppies get excited about babies; the children go to the hospital to meet a new baby.
Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

When primatologists Zooli and Gil are looking in the rainforest for a silverback gorilla, they're chased into an ancient temple by a robotic silverback that turns out to be a tiny marmoset guarding a sanctuary of mountain gorillas.
Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.
Molly's friend needs the Guppies' help to finish her work in time to attend the Big Beach Ball.
Skipper Molly and First Mate Gil are shipwrecked on Volcano Island, and it's about to erupt; parts of their boat start to mysteriously disappear.
Gil and his friends attend a basketball game played by elephants.
When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore.
The Bubble Guppies head to the supermarket to shop for fruits, vegetables and a box of Bubble Bites for Bubble Puppy.

When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.
Molly performs in the quick-change dress-up match during Fashion Week in Bubbletucky and ends up on the cover of a fashion magazine.
Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.
On the hottest day of the year, Rangers Goby and Gil's job is to make sure pedestrians reach the lake safely; however, Bigfoot causes issues when he removes the stop signs from the park.

In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.
Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.
Mail carrier Molly tries to deliver a Friendship Day card for someone named Alison in a place called Wonderland; the card-stealing Queen of Hearts bans Friendship Day across the land.
On the Shimmy-Shimmy Islands, everyone's preparing for Queen Zooli's dance party, but each time they practice, a huge wave splashes them.

Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.
Blaze and AJ spend the day with some very special trucks: Blaze's mother, father and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they're the world's fastest family.
Gasquatch invites Blaze and AJ to his ice cream party, but forgets the ice cream; Blaze transforms into an ice cream truck and races to reach Gasquatch's house in time.
Big Rig Blaze is called upon to make three big deliveries all over Axle City, but might need help to finish in time.
